raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速。跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，取得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear, hung out and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。外閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W3W) Held up from wide draw, still last top of home straight when short of room briefly, stayed on between horses.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。直路初仍居包尾位置，一度空位不足。在馬匹之間保持走勢。
（騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W1W1W) Sat rear, made the turn wide, not much ground made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W1W1W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時走外疊。直路上追前不多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Rear of mid-field, one paced under pressure final 300m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards rear in 9th or 8th, switched wide for a run into straight, made short-lived effort at about the 200M, made no further impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列第八或第九位。入直路時移出外疊取位。約二百米處一度發力，末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W) Sat towards the rear on the rail, made ground along the rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段沿欄追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Shifted in abruptly and bumped heavily out of stalls, raced wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 出閘時急促向內斜跑及發生大力碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, held up over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Recovered from slow start to race in mid-field, stayed on final 200m but lacked pace to trouble front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。最後二百米保持走勢，但速度不足以威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, held up between 350M to 300M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。三百五十米處至三百米處之間受困。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Soon taken well back from the widest barrier, wide into straight, found nothing under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即遙居於後。入直路時走外疊。末段在催策下再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。五百米處受催策。二百米處轉移跑線以望空，但缺乏速度。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, gave ground rounding the Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列。轉直路彎時墮退。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In touch with leaders, pushed along 300m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受推策，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Began well from gate 13, positioned a length behind the leader on the stands' side, no clear run until final 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;自第十三檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄。未能望空直至五十米處。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Dipped shortly after the start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久將頭低俯，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Taken back from gate 8, positioned 3 wide with cover, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留後，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke fairly and settled midfield the rail, stayed at the same pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, checked 350m out, passed a few tiring rivals, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處勒避。超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, rail position, ridden to chase leader 350m out, no extra 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。三百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field, ridden along towards centre of course 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。四百米處在跑道中央受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on rail, 3 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
(Jockey dropped whip near 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。
（騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於接近二百米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, set strong pace, headed top of home straight, bumped and lost balance 250m out, well beaten.
(Lost right hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，以快步速領放。直路初被超越。二百五十米處被碰撞，失去平衡。所負甚遠。
（失去右後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, short of room 250m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。二百五十米處空位不足。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。留居後列，落後五至六個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1100M, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前，取得領先。千一米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace until approaching final 50M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速直至趨近最後五十米，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide in midfield early, dropped towards rear 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, closed off well without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處墮居後列。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Jumped awkwardly, held up, last entering home straight, passed a few under pressure late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘笨拙，留後。入直路時居包尾位置。末段在催策下超越數匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, failed to quicken in the straight. (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast into stride, raced prominently on the inside, allowed the rival to cross near 500M, a length or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展步迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近五百米處時讓對手過頭，入直路時落後約一個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 800m out, ran on well in home straight but always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上以佳勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, minor progress made, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。略為上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Crowded start, unable to slot in, trapped wide in midfield on the outside, slightly taken back approaching 700M, found cover near 650M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫，未能切入，居中間位置，走外疊。趨近七百米處時稍為留後。接近六百五十米處時取得遮擋。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。末段以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Away with them, taken back to race at rear, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步出閘，其後留居後列。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Settled one back in 3rd on rail within 2L of pace, angled out for a run entering home straight and faded gradually out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居第三位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。其後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began well, raced prominently on the outside, a length back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat at rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W5W) Made contact at start, positioned 2 wide, 3 lengths or so back, angled out 600M, same margin back turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出。入直路時落後相同距離。衝刺強勁，跑入亞席，僅以一馬頭位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Held up from wide draw, under pressure in last turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘，留後。轉入直路時居包尾位置，受催策。瞬即落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven along 550m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Hampered shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 起步後不久受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, weakened 500M, eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。五百米處轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W1W1W1W) Jumped okay and led, traveled okay, weakened at the top of the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘尚可，領放，走勢不俗。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Waited with towards rear, pushed along 450m out towards centre of course, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)居後列，留力候上。四百五十米處在跑道中央受推策，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, headed near 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。接近二百米處時被超越，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, limited response when asked, could not be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對催策反應平平。末段緊迫競跑時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 350m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, followed winner into home straight, lacked pace to hold position from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時跟隨頭馬上前。自直路初起未能增速以保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Raced towards centre of course, mid division, ridden along 350m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)在跑道中央競跑，居中間位置。三百五十米處受催策，保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Jumped well from the widest draw, taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，留居尾列。入直路時落後約八個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on outer, 5 lengths or so back in the middle stages, finished off very strongly to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。中段落後約五個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, dropped away in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bounded as stalls opened, rail position in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 開閘時向上跳躍，居中間之後位置，走內欄。半程時上前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持走勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Sat rear, raced keenly in the middle stages and had to be checked, angled out making the Turn, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列。中段搶口，須勒避。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear 2 wide, steadied at the early stages, started to make progress rounding Home Turn, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。早段收慢。轉直路彎時開始推進。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken across from wide draw, raced towards rear, stayed on at the one pace under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入內疊，居後列。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Keen towards rear, forward move out wide into mid-field at halfway, headway 300m out, shifted left briefly 200m out, stayed on well, every chance final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，搶口。半程時上前至中間位置，走外疊。三百米處追前。二百米處一度向外斜跑。末段保持佳勢，最後五十米已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 500M, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近五百米處時走第二疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W3W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, made steady progress over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W3W) 居前列，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Took up running on rail over 1300M out, increased tempo early in back straight kicking over 2.5L clear, came back to the field rounding home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 千三米處取得領先，走內欄。對面直路初加速帶離逾兩個半馬位。轉直路彎時被馬群追上。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to improve position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能追前。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward to hold a position ahead of midfield, ran home one paced, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前，居中間之前位置。末段保持同速，瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W2W) Sat last 2 wide, hung in in the Straight, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W2W) 居包尾位置，走第二疊。直路上內閃。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, three wide in mid-field with cover, hung right in home straight and switched 150m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路上內閃。一百五十米處轉換跑線。末段走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, raced very wide without cover throughout, widest into home straight, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 早段受催策，未能跟上步速，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處被拋離時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W1W) Dropped back to last on jumping from wide draw, saved ground on the inside but still had plenty to do 400M, failed to run on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。走內疊節省腳程，但四百米處仍落後甚遠。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Settled behind midfield 3 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield, 3 wide, 5 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Crowded briefly soon after start, three wide in rear, widest on bend, stayed on final 150m, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步後不久一度受擠迫，居後列，走第三疊。直路彎走最外疊。最後一百五十米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W4W) Waited with in rear, under pressure 600m out, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處受催策。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Held up in last pair, outpaced early in home straight, late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路初被拋離。末段追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W2W) Commenced well, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 650M, same margin back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內疊。自六百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上移出外疊，末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄居中間之後位置。直路初受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Dropped back from draw 1 to race in midfield, had over 4Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘後墮居中間位置。四百米處落後逾四個馬位。末段未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W4W) From a wide draw taken back to race behind midfield, wide into straight, wound up strongly to get pretty close in the end.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居中間之後位置。入直路時走外疊。衝刺強勁，過終點時所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, forced to steady top of home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初被迫收慢。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on when in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段在望空下追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Prominent briefly and soon dropped to wide in worse than midfield, produced moderate short-lived effort early in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 一度居前列，瞬即墮居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路初一度發力，走勢普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W1W) Sat worse than midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back after halfway, angled wide over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程後墮後。二百米處移出外疊。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢不俗。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Waited with, under pressure in rear turning into home straight, strong run on wide outside final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上。轉入直路時居後列，受催策。最後一百五十米在外疊走勢強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, under pressure from the 450M, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。自四百五十米處起受催策。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled some 3L back in 5th or 6th, drifted backward to 7th when pace quickened over 800M out, kept on same pace early in straight with some late headway closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居第五或第六位，落後約三個馬位。八百米處在步速加快之際墮居第七位。直路早段保持同速。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Fast into stride, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' rail, hard ridden approaching 300M, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;展步迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走外欄。趨近三百米處時受力策。保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊，直路上追前頗多，取得第四名，未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, followed runner-up through 700m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Under pressure to hold a position behind midfield, didn't respond turning for home. (Jockey - failed to travel throughout and was not comfortable on the Yielding track. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 受催策以保持中間之後位置。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠順，不適應「黏地」的場地狀況。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled mainly with 2L of pace in 5th or 4th, ran on under pressure to hit the front narrowly 150M out only to be caught final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 大多居第四或第五位，落後領放馬兩個馬位。受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先。僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, obtained clear running until near the 250M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時望空。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along 500m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百米處受推策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled handy, traveled smoothly, kept on well to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (4W3W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, strode forward in the middle stages and crossed the lead, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(4W3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。中段展步上前，超越領放馬。末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持強勁走勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped well from gate 12, raced prominently on the outside, slightly taken back after passing 1200M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。跑過千二米處後稍為留後，走第二疊。中段落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Taken across to a rail spot soon after the start, near last 8Ls off the pace making the home turn, couldn't go on in the straight. Never in the picture.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後瞬即移入內欄位置。轉直路彎時居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路上無以為繼。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From gate 6 not contesting the speed and settled fourth last, made up some ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第六檔出閘，未有爭奪領先，居尾四位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground against rail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列。直路初仍居後列。末段沿欄略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初在催策下反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Outpaced towards rear of mid-field from halfway, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自半程起被拋離，居中間之後位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear, 2 away from the stands' rail, switched to the middle track after passing 400M, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外欄第三疊。跑過四百米處後移至跑道中央。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) In rear after awkward start, ridden along from 550m out, wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 起步笨拙，其後居後列。自五百五十米處起受催策。入直路時走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress until no clear run in the closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。追前甚多，直至末段未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mustered no early speed and settled last, made up some steady ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段缺乏前速，居尾列。在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after awkward start, dropped to last place 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。六百米處墮後至包尾位置。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, mid division, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走大外疊。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, pushed along 500m out to chase leader, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受推策，追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W3W) Bustled along after the start to obtain a position ahead of midfield, shifted in abruptly 500M resulting in rider losing balance, failed to pick up pace in the straight. (Warning placed on the horse's racing manners.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W3W) 起步後受催策以佔取中間之前位置。五百米處急促向內斜跑，導致騎師失去平衡。直路上未能加速。（小組就此駒的走勢發出警告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, found rail 600M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。六百米處移入內欄。轉入直路時未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Rear of mid-field, little response to pressure 300m out, well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處對催策無甚反應，遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling just off the pace on rail, remained in 3rd but further away from pacemaker in back straight, within 2L when 2nd turning in for home, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。對面直路上仍居第三位，但進一步落後領放馬。入直路時居第二位，落後不逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, restrained to race near last, driven along 500M, held up briefly near 200M but never going the pace to challenge leaders. (Jockey - no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，受約束，居接近包尾位置。五百米處受催策。接近二百米處時一度受困，但速度不足以挑戰領先馬匹。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, switched and driven 400m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處轉換跑線及受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on strongly, edged ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段以勁勢追前。五十米處取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W1W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off without threatening. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W1W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段展開衝刺，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Close up early, gradually drifted 3L back to 4th when tempo increased in back straight, gained 3rd from a tiring runner onto home bend and fought on steadily in home straight, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領先馬匹。對面直路上步速加快時逐漸墮居第四位，落後三個馬位。開始轉直路彎時超越一匹漸呈疲態的對手，進佔第三位。直路上持續力拼。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, checked briefly 500m out, one paced under pressure and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處一度勒避。在催策下保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled towards rear on the rail, saved ground in the turn, made some ground in the final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat 2 wide outside to the leader, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier but unable to obtain cover 3-wide despite taken 2L back onto home bend 1000M out, renewed effort to dispute lead 600M out but unable to sustain effort upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，走第三疊，未能取得遮擋。一千米處開始轉直路彎時留後兩個馬位。六百米處重新發力，上前爭奪領先，但入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Gradually shifted back early to rear of midfield very wide without cover, ridden slightly closer for 3-wide position with cover home bend, kept on under pressure from over 3L 5th into straight until faded inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 早段逐漸留居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎受催策，略為追近，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居第五位，落後逾三個馬位，在催策下保持走勢，直至最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made running, ran on strongly to go clear final 200m despite hanging left, very comprehensive winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。儘管外閃，但走勢強勁，最後二百米帶離對手。以壓倒性的優勢勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, challenged by rival early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路早段受對手挑戰。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Sent forward and lead, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Chased leader against stand rail, pushed along over 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;追趕領放馬，走外欄。三百米處受推策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, pushed along 500m out to maintain position, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以保持位置。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier but soon taken over 2L back travelling 3-wide without cover, similar into straight, fading when checked 200M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留後逾兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。二百米處勒避之際力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Never far off the pace, in the 6th spot at 400M less than 2L adrift of leader, failed to muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;沿途距離領放馬不遠。四百米處居第六位，落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。未能加速展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, short of room 250m out to 150m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。二百五十米處至一百五十米處之間空位不足。其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Hurried along early stages from gate 12 and positioned one off the outside rail just behind the leading division, boxed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第十二檔出閘，早段受催策，居領先馬匹稍後位置，走外欄第二疊。以佳勢力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) Shifted out at start, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)起步時向外斜跑。落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百米處時受力策。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, made contact near 600M, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened and eased final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近六百米處時發生觸碰。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再加速。最後五十米轉弱，收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never travelled. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途走勢欠順。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Not far off early stages gradually drifting backward to midfield over 700M out, folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百米處逐漸墮居中間位置。入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced close up, pushed up to challenge leader 150m out, bumped with that rival when shifting right final 100m, edged ahead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處受推策上前挑戰領放馬。最後一百米在向內斜跑之際與該駒互相碰撞。接近終點時取得領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader on rail, baulked for a run until the 300M after straightening, quickened to hold every chance only to be overshadowed final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。入直路後受困直至三百米處。加速，一度極具爭勝機會，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide, 1-1/2L back, 2 wide from 700M, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後一個半馬位，走第三疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear on the stands' side, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般。留居後列，靠近外欄競跑。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W3W) Caught wide, forward move to race outside of leading pair at halfway, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m, just held third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W3W) 走外疊。半程時上前，居領先兩駒外側。自二百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處開始發力，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, weakened quickly over 200m out.
(Jockey dropped whip at 150M.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。二百米處迅速轉弱。
（於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
（心律不正常。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division against far rail, briefly tight for room when under pressure 300m out, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，走外欄。三百米處受催策時一度受緊迫。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, hung out 900m out and raced intractably, widest into home straight, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。九百米處外閃，不易駕馭。入直路時走最外疊。其後未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Soon taken back to the tail-end from the widest barrier, trailed the field into straight, baulked behind runners after straightening, finished off the race well inside final 200M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即留居包尾位置。入直路時尾隨馬群。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後二百米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide no cover, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, chased leaders from 300m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after slow start, ran green, stayed on late down the wide outside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，其後居後列，走勢稚嫩。末段保持走勢，遠離外欄競跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield on the middle track in the early stages, peaked on run approaching 500M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，在跑道中央競跑。趨近五百米處時未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (4W3W3W) Sat off pace 3 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(4W3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) 3L back in 6th on rails most of the way, shifted out for a run upon straightening reaching 2L 3rd briefly 150M out, weakened noticeably inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 大部分途程居第六位，落後三個馬位，走內欄。入直路時向外移出取位。一百五十米處一度進佔第三位，落後兩個馬位。最後一百米顯著轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well until approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Sat handy, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced very wide throughout without cover, driven 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along top of home straight, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened final 150M, eased final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。最後七十五米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat near the rear 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居接近後列位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 350M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般。落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。三百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外欄。三百米處受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide early, got into 2 wide spot rounding the Home Turn, short of room top of the Straight, closed off reasonably well despite the inference.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路初空位不足。儘管受干擾，但末段衝刺頗佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail and chased leaders into home straight, responded to pressure to lead closing stages, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時移離內欄，追趕領先馬匹。末段對催策交出反應，取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly to 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。五百米處前走勢暢順。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, raced on outside of field, no impression under pressure, dropped away final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置，走外欄。在催策下毫無表現。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, took the lead 200M, headed 150M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Ridden along in the early stages to be one out one back, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段受催策，居第二疊第二位。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Disputed lead between horses, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在馬匹之間爭奪領先。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。保持走勢，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat on pace near the outside rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，靠近外欄競跑。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Pressed leader, good progress to lead halfway out, pushed along over 300m out, on top from there, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追迫領放馬。追前甚多，半程時取得領先。三百米處受推策，其後保持領先。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field, ridden along 400m out, stayed on well but hung out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但最後二百米外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the stands' rail, same position in the middle stages, not enough room until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄。中段居相同位置。空位不足直至一百五十米處。其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division towards centre of course, pushed along halfway out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。半程時受推策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate, raced prominently, difficult to settle in the early stages, made contact 900M, 2 lengths back on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時觸碰閘廂右側，居前列。早段難以穩定走勢。九百米處發生觸碰。直路彎落後兩個馬位。直路早段轉弱，最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, wider turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, dropped to midfield in the middle stages, hard ridden after passing 400M but showed no response, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。中段墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受力策，但毫無反應。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, clear run up inside rail early in straight and challenged over 200m out, soon no extra, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。直路初沿欄望空。二百米處受挑戰。瞬即再無餘力，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, headway to challenge 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處上前展開挑戰，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 500M, unable to obtain clear run until final 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。未能望空直至最後一百米。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to race prominently, 3/4L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時落後四分三馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced prominently on the inside, there to turn, kept on well until final 100M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居前列，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持佳勢至一百米處，最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow away and crowded at the start, switched to the middle part of track 300M out, stayed on fairly well inside final 200M, went third towards finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，受擠迫。三百米處移至跑道中央。最後二百米保持不俗走勢。趨近終點時跑入季席。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Challenged for the lead 3 wide, kept on nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Out in line, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持佳勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先二又四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away, sat worse than midfield on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路早段受困。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Rear of mid-field, stayed on for pressure, lacked pace to trouble leaders but promising debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。在催策下保持走勢。速度不足以威脅領先馬匹，但初出表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure 600m out to maintain position, weakened quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。六百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上迅速轉弱。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden on bend to chase leaders, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策以追趕領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 300m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速轉弱，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, driven along to chase leader 450m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Away in line, settled down midfield 4-5Ls off leader, failed to respond under pressure 500M, gave ground soon after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。五百米處對催策毫無反應。入直路後瞬即墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, keen, checked briefly 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，搶口。二百米處一度勒避。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。四百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Showed good speed to lead, headed by winner halfway out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;前速甚快，取得領先。半程時被頭馬超越。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Chased leaders, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Tracked leaders, unable to hold position halfway, flattened out final 200m.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。半程時未能保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Shared led on the stands' rail, weakened final furlong.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;並排領先，走外欄。最後二百米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Rail position in mid-field, raced very keenly middle stages, commenced move out wide 750m out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段十分搶口。七百五十米處開始發力，走外疊。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) From gate 13 sat handy with cover within striking distance of the leader, momentarily hit the front 250M out, boxed on nicely just unable to hold off late challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，居前列，落後領放馬不遠，有遮擋。二百五十米處一度取得領先。以佳勢力拼，但末段未能抗衡對手的挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced keenly throughout, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) One of quickest away from the stalls, raced keenly in the early stages, held up for a short distance early part of the straight, knuckled down to the task once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快馬匹之一。早段搶口。直路早段在一段短途程上受困。末段望空後瞬即力拼上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, good headway halfway out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向上跳躍及失地，居後列。半程時追前甚多。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon prominent despite awkward start, settled within 3L of pace in 4th early in back straight gaining to 2L 3rd 650M out, saved ground on rail turning in but soon faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即居前列。對面直路早段居第四位，落後領放馬不足三個馬位。六百五十米處進佔第三位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，但瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, raced slightly better than midfield on the stands' side, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，靠近外欄競跑。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened and gave ground in the Straight. (Unacceptable performance)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱及墮退。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 300M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。三百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Inconvenienced at start before travelling 3-wide without cover in midfield, in similar situation rounding home bend and yielded ground into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時受妨礙，其後居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時居相若位置。入直路時墮退。再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped well, settled on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield, trapped wide throughout, crowded near the 750M, unable to sustain his run final 200M (See Incident Report).
Lame in left front leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，沿途走外疊。接近七百五十米處時受擠迫。最後二百米後勁不繼。（見競賽事件報告。）
左前腿不良於行。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, took the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Started fast but unable to hold position, checked and back into mid-field halfway, one paced under pressure, checked briefly 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，但未能保持位置。半程時勒避，墮居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。二百米處一度勒避。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, similar position on turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, closed off nicely until checked at the 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。衝刺良佳，五十米處勒避。

raceinfo_eng.RaceName: THE HONG KONG COLLEGE OF EMERGENCY MEDICINE 30TH ANNIVERSARY CUP (HANDICAP)

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄
raceinfo_chi.RaceName: 香港急症科醫學院30周年紀念盃（讓賽）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W4W) Crowded early, raced in mid-field, wide and under pressure turning into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W4W) 早段受擠迫，居中間位置。轉入直路時受催策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Badly crowded at start losing ground, tailed-off most of the way, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫及失地。大部分途程居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled wide in rear of midfield, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時受催策。最後一百五十米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in midfield from moderate start some 3L off the pace, drifted slightly further back onto course proper, renewed effort under pressure inside final 200M, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。跑離分支直路時略為墮後。最後二百米受催策時再度發力，穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, ended up racing at the back of the field, failed to make any real progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。最後四百米無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, unable to pick up for pressure against rail from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。自四百米處起沿欄在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From a low draw obtained a midfield position along the inside, couldn't go on passing 300M, weakened to last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自內檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過三百米處時無以為繼。轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, ran on well to lead 150m out, headed close home, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢追前，一百五十米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on outer, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, ran on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Began well from gate 11, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, showed some dash, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。略為加速上前。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Across to track leader, ridden along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on steadily but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 切入以跟隨領放馬。六百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W) Ridden from the widest draw settling one back in 2nd 850M out, improved to take up running 440M out holding over 1L advantage into straight, kept on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策。八百五十米處居第二位，落後一個馬位。上前，四百四十米處取得領先。入直路時領先逾一個馬位。末段在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W) Tracked clear leader, gave chase from 400m out, overhauled that rival 100m out, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W) 跟隨遙遙領先的領放馬。自四百米處起追趕領放馬。一百米處超越該駒。走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Began fairly settling just worse than midfield in 8th, came under pressure rounding home bend, kept on steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後的第八位。轉直路彎時受催策。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Away well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out approaching 300M, made contact early in straight, kept on well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。趨近三百米處時向外移出。直路早段與對手互相觸碰。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, 4 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly, won by 3/4L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段衝刺強勁，以四分三個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, closed off well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。衝刺良佳，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W2W3W) Raced in touch, forward move turning into home straight, stayed on well to lead 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時上前。保持佳勢，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced towards rear on the outside, slightly improved on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為推進。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, stayed on but crossed by runner-up 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前。保持走勢，但五十米處被亞軍馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Across to press leader, challenged leader from 400m out, dropped away quickly final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。自四百米處起挑戰領放馬。最後一百五十米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。一百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Raced outside of leader, unable to quicken with that rival 300m out, stuck to task, stayed on closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。三百米處未能與領放馬一同加速。末段在力拼下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield but trapped wide early, sent forward after passing 700M, took the lead 600M, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後受催策上前。六百米處取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Travelled wide throughout after beginning from a wide barrier, improved steadily from towards rear to reach 2L 4th in back straight 800M out, drifted wider into straight and soon weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後沿途走外疊。自後列穩步上前，八百米處在對面直路上進佔第四位，落後兩個馬位。入直路時移出較外疊。瞬即轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Began well settling mainly some 3L back on rail in 7th, made steady headway around home bend and steadied on heels 550M out, obtained a run in joint 2nd 300M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，大多居第七位，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時穩步上前，五百五十米處收慢避開他駒後蹄。三百米處進佔並列第二位，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened and faded in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
