runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上轉弱及力竭。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, one pace when asked
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) One of the first few away and tracked leaders, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘最快數駒之一，跟隨領先馬匹。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Disputed led in three wide, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and able to lead the race at steady tempo, headed near 200M, weakened final stages but managed to hang on for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，能以穩定步速領放。接近二百米處時被超越。末段轉弱，但仍能保住季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Average to begin, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W2W3W) Tracked leader, failed to respond passing 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。跑過二百五十米處時對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards the rear, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (4W2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
(Jockey dropped right rein at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。走勢尚可。末段穩步追前。
（於二百五十米處騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百五十米處騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W2W) Sat behind midfield, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 6 lengths back, 2 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後六個馬位，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段對催策反應平平，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, under pressure early in home straight, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, good headway on bend to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W3W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, 9 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat rear, raced rear, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 沿途居後列。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to join race leader early in back straight, commenced move home bend and hit the front from tiring leader upon straightening, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 120M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，在對面直路早段追上領放馬。直路彎開始上前。入直路時超越漸呈疲態的領放馬，取得領先。其後無以為繼，最後一百二十米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。自三百米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Recovered quickly from moderate start to lead after the first 100M setting a sound pace, ceded advantage for 2nd spot onto home bend, remained prominent in 3rd into straight but folded up quickly inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，迅速恢復走勢，過了首一百米後取得領先，以快步速領放。開始轉直路彎時被超越，居第二位。入直路時居前列第三位，但最後二百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, stayed on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先，保持佳勢。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure to hold position 500m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策以保持位置。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced in midfield on the outside, hampered near 850M, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自第十檔出閘後留居中間位置，走外疊。接近八百五十米處時受阻礙。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled handy, raced wide and without cover, weakened over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊，沒有遮擋。末段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped ok and settled slightly worse than midfield, made minor progress final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘尚可，居中間稍後位置。最後一百五十米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Shifted out at start and bumped, raced at rear on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居後列，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W2W) Tracked pace, improved alongside winner home straight, ran on well final 100m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上與頭馬一同上前。最後一百米走勢良佳。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 500m out to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Mid-field, switched inside 200m out, stayed on well final 100m and nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處向內移入。最後一百米保持佳勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。自三百米處起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out fast, stranded 3 wide no cover throughout, stuck on gamely despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘迅速，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay on the rail, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, widest into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走最外疊。毫無表現。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Sent to the lead from wide draw, dictated steady pace, ridden 300m out, closed down final 100m but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後在催策下領先，以平穩步速領放。三百米處受催策。最後一百米被追近，但保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Settled just over 2L back in 4th, quickened under pressure 300M out reaching 2nd but over 3L off the leader and eventual winner just over 200M out, lost the quinella spot late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位。三百米處在催策下加速，就在二百米處進佔第二位，但落後領放馬兼頭馬逾三個馬位。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, had to wait for run from top of home straight until 300m out, effort to chase leaders until no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自直路早段起須等待空位出現直至三百米處。在催策下追趕領先馬匹，最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Away in line , stayed close to leaders throughout, worked into the race well, moved up and vied for lead passing 300M, couldn't keep up with first two late but held 3rd comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。走勢良佳，跑過三百米處時上前爭奪領先。末段未能跟上首兩名馬匹，但從容取得季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, a bit closer on turn, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, wider turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, held up at the top of the Straight, not much response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。直路初受困。對催策反應不大。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Settled handy, raced wide, weakened notably inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。最後二百米顯著轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。轉入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched inside for clear run 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百米處移入內疊以望空。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, improved from the 700M, kept on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自七百米處起推進上前。末段保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on very well to the line, won by 2Ls. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，以兩個馬位之先勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W2W) Sat last, made some minor late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W2W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Jumped nicely from draw 3, allowed to find his feet early stages and settled down in midfield, stayed on mildly final 400M to claim 4th near line without threatening top three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自第三檔出閘良佳，早段獲許順其自然地競跑，居中間位置。最後四百米保持一般走勢，接近終點時進佔第四位，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Settled wide in midfield dropping to last few rounding home bend, widest runner into straight, made no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮居最後數位。入直路時走最外疊。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, checked and lost its running near the 250M, not much found thereafter (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時勒避，失去跑線，其後無甚餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Settled in last few from a poor draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自第十檔出閘，居最後數位之內。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, traveled okay, held up at the straight, finished off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。直路上受困。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持佳勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, saved ground, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 950m out, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。九百五十米處移出外疊開始發力。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Settled behind midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, dropped to last place 750m out and soon ridden, passed a few tiring rivals in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。七百五十米處墮居包尾位置，瞬即受催策。直路上超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat towards rear, always rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 沿途居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced 3 wide no cover off midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off nicely (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover behind midfield, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W6W) Away well but soon restrained to a rearward position, travelled well into home turn and made solid progress from 600M, ran home strongly final stages and just prevailed in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W6W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即受約束，居後列。進入直路彎時走勢良佳。自六百米處起追前甚多。末段衝刺強勁，在與亞軍馬匹幾乎齊過終點下僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W) Led, traveled smoothly, kept on nicely to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W) 領放。走勢暢順。保持佳勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders on the rail, weakened and faded in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。直路上轉弱及力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W2W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, 2 wide from 900M, 6 lengths back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。自九百米起走第二疊。中段落後六個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。三百米處被超越。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, kept on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W4W) Sat towards the rear 3 wide, stayed on, nothing extra final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。保持走勢。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Sat behind mid, angled out entering the Straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時向外移出。走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Restrained from wide draw and dropped out in rear, still in last pair entering home straight, stayed on final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後受約束，墮居後列。入直路時仍居最後兩位之內。最後一百五十米保持走勢。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat against the fence midfield, briefly blocked for a run, stayed on ok, something further would suit.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。一度受困而未能望空。末段保持尚可走勢。增程角逐或更合發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Mid-field, forced wide and tight for room turning into home straight, again short of room 200m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時被迫走外疊，受緊迫。二百米處再度空位不足。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind mid, raced wide and without cover from the 800M, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，自八百米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, under pressure to challenge over 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處在催策下展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, headway halfway as leading trio came back to field, improved to lead 150m out, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。半程時上前，追及被馬群追上的領先三駒。推進，一百五十米處取得領先。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, easily scored. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，從容獲勝。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat at the rear, hung in and never seriously tested. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。內閃。從未能真正施為。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Dropped in from wide draw, raced in last pair, pushed along final bend, stayed on late, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入，居最後兩位。直路彎受推策。末段保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Taken back on jumping, settled at the rear 10Ls back, maintained his spot to the bend, still miles back top of the straight and was unable to make any impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘後留居後列，落後十個馬位。直路彎前保持位置。直路初仍落後甚遠。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, angled out early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。三百米處望空。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W2W3W) Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, still 9 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made good progress in the run home to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W2W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路彎仍落後九個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段追前甚多，獲得季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Held up last, some headway final bend, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, strong run to edge ahead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路彎略為追前。未能望空直至一百五十米處。走勢強勁，接近終點時取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, kept on.
Rider's whip got knocked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover in front of midfield, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, weakened from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）
