runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W3W) From wide draw taken back to last, pressed along home turn and had 7Ls to make up on leader 400M, took time to get going and commenced to finish off well final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路彎受催策。四百米處落後領放馬七個馬位。加速需時。最後二百米開始以不俗走勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Crowded on jumping, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 躍出時受擠迫，沿途居後列，從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W5W) Sat behind mid, traveled fairly well, made good progress from 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。走勢不俗。自二百五十米處起追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W4W4W) Taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made very good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W4W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時未能望空，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W3W2W2W1W) Ridden hard to sit handy, raced wide in the early stages until near the 1000M, gave ground notably from the Back Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W3W2W2W1W) 在力策下居前列。早段走外疊直至接近一千米處。自對面直路起顯著墮退。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, struggling to hold position final bend, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Forced wider on the track early stages and shuffled back to last 8Ls or so off the leader, made up several places out wide 800m out, soon tired out early in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 早段被迫走較外疊，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬約八個馬位。八百米處追前數位，走外疊。直路初瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Crowded at start, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Began well, raced prominently, took the lead 1350M, led by a length in the middle stages, kept on well to hold off the challengers, won by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列。一千三百五十米處取得領先。中段領先一個馬位。保持佳勢，力拒對手的挑戰，以一馬頭位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Squeezed out shortly after start, in rear, headway from 300m out after forced to wait for room briefly, no threat to leaders but staying on when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。須一度等待空位出現，其後自三百米處起追前。末段空位不足，保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away fast to take the lead, took them along at steady pace middle stages, headed by rivals nearing 200M, no extra final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段以平穩步速領放。接近二百米處時被對手超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival from 600M, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。自六百米處起受對手挑戰，直路早段保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Shifted in at start, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Began smartly from gate 13, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked on run 300M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Went forward tracking leaders, handy enough early straight but gave in easily and was weak from 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 上前跟隨領先馬匹。直路初居前列，但迅速墮退。自二百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled midfield, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Away well enough, up with early pace before easing back to sit behind leaders, challenged strongly for the lead from 250M, led nearing 50M but was caught by winner last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘頗佳，早段跟上步速，其後收慢留居領先馬匹之後。自二百五十米處起以勁勢上前挑戰，爭奪領先。接近五十米處時取得領先，但最後一步被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier to share the pace 2-wide, drifted slightly backward rounding home bend before hitting the front just inside the 400M, kicked over 1L clear 200M out only to be swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，並排領先，走第二疊。轉直路彎時略為墮退。跑過四百米處後取得領先。二百米處加速帶離逾一個馬位，僅於最後一百米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, short of room against rail top of home straight, checked 200m out, lost all chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。直路初走內欄，空位不足。二百米處勒避。再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, taken widest into home straight, ran on well to challenge 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走最外疊。二百米處以佳勢追前以展開挑戰。末段呈疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled about 6L off the pace in 4th on rail, in similar position into straight, fought on steadily without threatening the place-getters.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居第四位，落後領放馬約六個馬位，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置。末段持續力拼，但未能威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W) Jumped well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, 2 wide, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，走第二疊。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Rushed forward and crossed to the lead 750M, fought hard early straight trying to hold on for the lead, headed near 150M before fading away late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策上前，七百五十米處切入領放。直路早段力拼，嘗試保持領先。接近一百五十米處時被超越。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well until 100M, peaked and headed 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位，保持佳勢至一百米處。五十米處未能再增速及被超越，接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Fast break, made all, kicked and quickened early in home straight, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。直路初加速，帶離對手。末段領先距離收窄，但保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, pressed in front, headed 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。在領放下受追迫。三百米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Fast break, made running, pressed by runner-up throughout, headed 350m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。沿途被亞軍馬匹追迫。三百五十米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, pressed in front, pressed on 350m out, headed by winner 50m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。三百五十米處受催策。五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Moderately away, raced 2 better than midfield in the early stages, found rail approaching 800M, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。趨近八百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well and raced in a share of lead, ridden and opened up clear advantage from 300m out, just kept up to work final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，並排領先。自三百米處起受催策及拋離對手。最後五十米僅保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Average to begin, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，緊隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, ridden along 400m out to chase leaders, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened early to lead 350m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。率先加速，三百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2-1/2L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個半馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced prominently on the inside, 1/4L back turning in, kept on well to take 2nd, always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Caught wide early from draw 10 before obtaining a prominent spot outside leader 700M out, fought hard in the straight vying for the lead, kept on well to the line only beaten narrowly by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，早段走外疊。七百米處佔取領放馬外側的前列位置。直路上力拼，爭奪領先。末段保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked leading pair, impeded briefly 200m out when trying to make effort, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處嘗試發力時一度受阻。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。三百五十米處加速。末段以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Chased leader, didn't travel with much fluency, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢欠順。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made all, pressed in front, responded well when pressed on 300m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 一放到底。在領放下受追迫。三百米處在催策下反應良佳。保持佳勢，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Waited with in rear, briefly hampered 1000m out, tight for room early in home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。一千米處一度受阻礙。直路早段受緊迫。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, settled towards the rear of the main group 4Ls off the pace, responded moderately final 300M, was making some progress on leaders but couldn't be ridden out late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬四個馬位。最後三百米對催策反應普通，略為追近領先馬匹，但末段未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, towards rear, had to wait for run between 400m out and 300m out, stayed on, nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。四百米處至三百米處之間須等待空位出現。保持穩勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders out wide, stayed in contention until no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。保持爭逐機會，直至最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, forced to steady on heels 800m out, switched inside for clear run 300m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處被迫收慢避開他駒後蹄。三百米處移入內疊以望空。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Restrained to race at the back of the main group about 4Ls off the pace, ran home fairly and was never going the pace to challenge leaders.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 受約束，居主馬群後列，落後領放馬約四個馬位。末段衝刺一般。從未能加速挑戰領先馬匹。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Given a waiting ride towards the rear, 4Ls to make up 400M, closed off well to take 4th close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)居後列，留力候上。四百米處落後四個馬位。衝刺良佳，接近終點時進佔第四位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, keen middle stages, driven along 500m out, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置。中段搶口。五百米處受催策。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Blundered out of stalls, held up, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘時失蹄，留後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled down midfield 3Ls off leaders, ran on steadily final 300M for 3rd but couldn't quite get to first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領先馬匹三個馬位。最後三百米以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍，但未能追上首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from the one draw gradually settling some 2L back in 4th or 3rd on rail, soon came to challenge on straightening holding every chance over 150M out, swamped for a placing in final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，逐漸居第三或第四位，落後約兩個馬位，走內欄。入直路時瞬即展開挑戰。一百五十米處一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後數步被超越，失去位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Pressed forward after moderate start from the widest draw, settled in 9th 3-wide with cover, became 10th past 700M, obtained clear passage down the centre of track over 200M out, finished off strongly to snatch victory final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘一般，受催策上前，居第九位，走第三疊，有遮擋。跑過七百米處時居第十位。二百米處望空，在跑道中央競跑，衝刺強勁，最後數步獲得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Bumped at the start, switched off to race in detached last 8-9Ls off the pace, had plenty to do 300M but ran past beaten horses only. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置，遙遙落後領放馬八至九個馬位。三百米處仍落後頗遠，但末段僅能超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along final bend, challenged up rail from 200m out, tight for room and bumped 150m out, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。一百五十米處受緊迫及發生碰撞。以佳勢上前，過終點時險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well before easing back to race in midfield, lay in home straight and proved difficult to ride under 7lb claimer, did best work late to claim 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，收慢留居中間位置。直路上內閃，在獲減七磅的騎師胯下難以策騎。末段表現最佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W) Gradually taken back from the widest draw, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W) 自最外檔出閘後逐漸留後。從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Close up early, dropped towards rear approaching the 1000M bend, remained in a similar position to home straight, fought on steadily under pressure despite a tight run just inside the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段緊隨領放馬。趨近一千米處彎位時墮居後列。直路前仍居相若位置。儘管於跑過二百米處後緊迫競跑，但在催策下持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, headway up rail and made up several places in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路上沿欄追前數位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat near the rear 2 wide, made no impression
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to press leader, challenged leader early in home straight, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，追迫領放馬。直路初挑戰領放馬。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Broke well from a poor draw before taken back to 5th over 4L back, further away when pace quickened around home bend, hung in inconvenienced rider over 200M out but ran on well inside final 200M, just failed to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，其後留居第五位，落後逾四個馬位。轉直路彎賽事步速加快時落後更遠。二百米處內閃以致騎師受妨礙，但最後二百米走勢良佳。終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W2W) Bumped out of stalls, across to press leader, struggled to hold position from 600m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，切入以追迫領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to hold position early stages, angled out 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。早段未能保持位置。五百米處向外移出。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Stumbled leaving stalls and bumped shortly after start, in rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, ran on well to move into second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時失蹄，其後不久與對手互相碰撞，居後列。直路初移出外疊以望空。以佳勢追前，接近終點時進佔第二位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled down behind leaders along the fence, came through strongly to challenge for the lead 250M, all out final stages to beat off the persistent runner up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居領先馬匹之後，走內欄。以勁勢上前，二百五十米處爭奪領先。末段全力拼鬥，擊敗緊追不捨的亞軍馬匹掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Box seat, short of room top of home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初空位不足。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Began well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, there to turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W) Chased leaders along the fence, within striking distance turning home, responded well and dug deep final 200M to overhaul the long-time leader near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。入直路時落後領放馬不遠。最後二百米對催策反應良佳，持續力拼，接近終點時超越沿途帶頭的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed near 250M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。接近二百五十米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Quickly away, soon in front and led uncontested to the straight, headed mid-straight then faded to finish 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，瞬即帶頭，單騎領放至直路。直路中段被超越，其後力竭，以第四名過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 13 showed customary pace to cross to the lead , became immediately under pressure when challenged by rival nearing 300M before giving ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十三檔出閘，展現一貫前速，切入領放。接近三百米處時受對手挑戰之際立即受催策，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last on the rail, made some headway on the inside.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居尾列，走內欄。末段沿內疊略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) In rear after sluggish start, unable to hold position from 500m out, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。自五百米處起未能保持位置。洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders against rail, good headway middle stages, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與他駒互相碰撞。緊隨領先馬匹，走內欄。中段追前甚多。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 100M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。末段保持甚佳走勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) Settled in rear of mid-field, switched towards centre of course for clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)居中間之後位置。三百米處移向跑道中央以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) Sat 2 off the outside rail midfield, took some time to respond, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)居中間位置，走外欄第三疊。需時對催策作出反應。末段保持走勢。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, took some time to respond, ran on final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。需時對催策作出反應。最後一百五十米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Went forward tracking the pace on the stand's side, kept up with leaders from 400M, raced tight along the fence and had difficulty obtaining clear running between 150M-50M. Held by leaders final stages.
(Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;沿外欄上前跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起持續追趕領先馬匹。沿外欄緊迫競跑，一百五十米處至五十米處之間難以望空，末段未能追上領先馬匹。
（右前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。直路早段未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, mid division, shifted right in home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居中間位置。直路上向內斜跑。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Crowded at start, wide in midfield early stages, gained 4th within 3L of pace 600M out, ran on under pressure in straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫。早段居中間位置，走外疊。六百米處進佔第四位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。直路上在催策下追前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat just behind the speed 2 off the stands' rail, closed off nicely, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居領放馬稍後位置，走外欄第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W) Tracked pace 2 wide, there to turn, ran on evenly to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。走勢平穩，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Raced in clear third a few lengths behind leading pair, stuck to task under pressure final 250m but one paced, unable to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居領先兩駒之後頗遠的第三位，落後數個馬位。最後二百五十米在催策下持續力拼，但保持同速。未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, kicked 300m out, headed by winner 100m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。在領放下受追迫。三百米處加速。一百米處被頭馬超越，但持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚佳前速以領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局，從容獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再加速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Stayed close to leaders, raced keenly in the middle stages when pace was steadied, briefly held up for clear running 400M but couldn't go on afterwards.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 保持緊隨領先馬匹。中段在步速減慢時搶口。四百米處一度受困而未能望空，但其後無以為繼。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from draw 1 and sat in 3rd, had difficulty obtaining clear running passing for some distance passing 250M but the finishing response was only when fair late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第三位。跑過二百五十米處時在一段途程上難以望空，但末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, hung in and found nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列。其後內閃。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly from a wide barrier bumping others, travelled wide in rear of midfield most of the way, ran home at the one pace inside final 200M.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘笨拙，碰撞他駒。大部分途程居中間之後位置，走外疊。最後二百米以均速衝刺。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well from a middle barrier, travelled in 2nd 3-wide without cover before gaining 2-wide position onto home bend, held every chance in straight until outsprinted by the winner inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，最後一百五十米被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) From draw 1 sat handily behind leaders, moved up to challenge for the lead early straight, led inside 200M and had every chance, caught by first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初上前爭奪領先。二百米處取得領先，一度甚具爭勝機會。末段被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Not far off early, improved to one-out-one-back 600M out, hit the front over 250M out only to find no extra inside final 100M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 早段落後不遠。六百米處推進至第二位，走第二疊。二百五十米處取得領先，僅於最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced very wide with the leaders holding narrow advantage between the 800 and 600M, close-up in 2nd on rail turning into straight, unable to draw level throughout and swamped for 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與領先馬匹並跑，走大外疊。八百米處至六百米處之間以短距離領先。轉入直路時沿欄追近，居第二位，但一直未能追上頭馬。最後數步被超越，失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Began well, dropped back to a midfield position on settling, ran on fairly passing 400M, not ridden out late sages when awkward placed behind rivals.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處時走勢一般。末段在對手之後處於窘境之際未能被力策。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Always prominent, just over 2L off the pace into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 一直居前列。入直路時落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped on terms, raced 3-wide no cover in midfield, kept battling final 300M but unable to quicken. Steadied 50M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，但未能加速。五十米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider final bend, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (5W3W3W) Held up in mid-division, wide into straight before running on strongly to take lead nearing 100M. Won his 4th race of season with something in hand.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(5W3W3W) 留居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，接近一百米處時取得領先。取得今季第四場頭馬，勝來猶有餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Obtained a trailing spot behind leaders, poised to strike top of the straight but the finishing response was only fair, found no extra close home. (Jockey - would derive a fitness benefit from tonight's run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 居領先馬匹之後，有遮擋。直路初蓄勢待發，但末段在催策下衝刺僅屬一般。接近終點時再無餘力。（騎師表示，坐騎應能從是賽中提升狀態。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (5W2W2W) Travelled wide in prominent positions early after beginning from a wide barrier, obtained one-out-one-back position approaching home bend, gained upper hand 200M out and held on well to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段居前列，走外疊。趨近直路彎時居第二疊第二位。二百米處佔得上風，保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持勁勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 2 to be chasing leader along the fence, weakened quickly passing 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，走內欄。跑過三百米處時迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) From widest draw unable to cross runners on its inside and raced very wide without cover in midfield for the majority of the race, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a non-threatening 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自最外檔出閘，未能超越內側馬匹，大部分途程居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，取得第五名，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處發力。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Dropped back to a rearward spot after the jump, driven along 500M, closed off steadily down the outside but had too much to make on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 出閘後墮居後列。五百米處受催策。末段在外疊以穩勢衝刺，但落後領先馬匹太遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) Jumped well from gate 14, raced prominently on rail, took the lead near 450M, peaked and headed near 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)自第十四檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄。接近四百五十米處時取得領先。接近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Crowded and unbalanced at start travelling wide without cover throughout, improved steadily to 2L 4th 600M out but lost position entering straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫及失去平衡。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處以穩勢進佔第四位，落後兩個馬位，但入直路時失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Chased leaders on rails, weakened out of contention under pressure inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 沿欄追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米在催策下轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞。跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly, momentarily racing wide without cover before ridden along to be outside the leader, battled on well but just couldn't hold off the winner over final 50m (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，一度走外疊，沒有遮擋。其後受催策上前，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Well there from a low draw, snatched up when crossed on rail 600M out, angled out from 2L 3rd 450M out for a clear run into straight but could only keep on at the one pace without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自內檔出閘，居好位。六百米處在內欄被過頭之際勒避。四百五十米處居第三位，落後兩個馬位，向外移出以於入直路時望空，但其後僅能保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From wide draw ended up chasing leaders in a 3-wide spot without cover, couldn't quicken enough on straightening, always held by leaders in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時加速力不足。末段一直未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped with the rest and gradually settled towards the rear, copped a check near the 600M, raced wide on turn 400M out, ran on comfortably to the finish under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，逐漸居後列。接近六百米處時勒避。四百米處轉彎時走外疊。在負頂磅下輕鬆上前掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Slow to being, sat worse than midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off well, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) In rear after slow start, steadied off heels on occasions, good headway up rail home straight, improving to chase leaders when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，數度收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路上沿欄追前甚多。末段推進上前，追趕領先馬匹，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Prominent, keen early, pushed along 400m out to chase leaders, looked like winner 300m out but weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，早段搶口。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處甚具勝望，但最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W2W) Prominent early stages, drifted some 3L off the pace about 900M out, in similar position in 5th rounding home bend swinging wide into straight, kept on at the one pace without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段居前列。約九百米處墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若的第五位。入直路時移出外疊。保持同速，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W5W) Unable to find cover from draw 6 and raced wide in midfield throughout, weakened away badly turning into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W5W) 自第六檔出閘，未能取得遮擋。沿途居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，碰撞對手。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sent forward and keen, pressed leader and clear of rest, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 受催策上前，搶口，追迫領放馬及帶離餘駒。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, 4 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，落後約四個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled well back, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;遙居於後。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, ran green in home straight, flattened out final 200m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路上走勢稚嫩。最後二百米洩氣。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Sooboog from Ginali, a daughter of Duporth. Horses by the same sire include Northern Fire Ball and Viva Firecracker. This fellow had fourteen starts for two wins (a 3yo+ maiden over 1015m and a handicap over 1000m) and five placings. He was given four trials for three placings in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under pressure, beaten 1-1/2Ls, over 1050m AWT in Conghua on October 8. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 1/2L, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「送寶」(Sooboog)之後，在港同父馬包括「北地烈馬」及「爆竹」等駒，生母出自「大抱負」(Duporth)。來港前在澳洲十四戰得兩勝五位，頭馬包括一場1015米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽，及一場1000米讓磅賽。抵港後四次試閘三次上名。10月8日出試從化泥地1050米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.5個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬半個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well settling over 2L back in 6th 2-wide near midfield, quickened well inside final 200M to snatch 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居接近中間的第六位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。最後二百米加速良佳。最後數步進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Prominent near the rail early, gradually drifted some 3L off the pace onto course proper, kept on one pace in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段居前列，靠近外欄競跑。跑離分支直路時逐漸墮後，落後領放馬約三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from the widest draw and soon taken well back travelling very wide without cover until the 500M, made some impression from last on rail into home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，瞬即遙居於後。在沒有遮擋下走外疊直至五百米處。入直路時自包尾位置沿欄略為追前，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, dropped to mid-field turning into home straight, briefly hampered 300m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時墮居中間位置。三百米處一度受阻礙。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from the middle draw, gradually settled 3-wide without cover 2L back in 5th over 600M out, drifted further off the pace rounding home bend and some 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自中檔出閘迅速。六百米處逐漸居第五位，落後兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時落後領放馬更遠。入直路時落後約四個馬位。持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Raced in last pair after sluggish start and lost ground, last place entering home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢及失地，居最後兩位內。入直路時居包尾位置，毫無表現。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Reserved behind midfield in a fast run race, became badly held up 250M and lost every chance. (Jockey questioned regarding his riding / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在快步速下留居中間之後位置。二百五十米處嚴重受困，失去爭勝機會。（騎師被查詢騎法。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, closed off without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段以勁勢衝刺，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in last few on rail from the widest barrier, saved ground in a similar position into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，居相若位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, headway out wide on bend, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎追前，走外疊。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Tracked leaders, dropped to mid-field 800m out, moved smoothly into contention 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處墮居中間位置。四百米處順勢上前挑戰。保持走勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Heavily bumped and lost balance out of stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, short of room top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，嚴重失去平衡。居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初空位不足。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Rear of mid-field, wide into home straight, headway onto heels of leaders 200m out, run flattened out when a bit tight for room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時走外疊。二百米處上前緊隨領先馬匹，末段在略受緊迫之際洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W2W3W) Jumped on terms, 4th on settling in fast run race, poised to strike turning home, led 250M and gave everything but just came up short late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，在快步速下居第四位。轉直路彎時蓄勢待發。二百五十米處取得領先。全力以赴，僅於末段不敵頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W1W1W) Pressed leader, improved to lead 1100m out, joined 500m out, headed 250m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W1W1W) 追迫領放馬。推進上前，千一米處取得領先。五百米處被追上。二百五十米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) From wide draw failed to show sufficient pace to go forward despite being ridden along, taken back to the rear 5-6Ls off the pace, swung wide for home and didn't finish off. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，雖然受催策，但未能展現足夠前速上前。留居後列，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。入直路時移出外疊，衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Ridden to 5th along rail within 2L of pace, improved steadily to lead or disputed from 900M out, unable to sustain effort inside final 300M and folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 在催策下居第五位，落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，走內欄。自九百米處起穩步上前以帶頭或爭奪領先。最後三百米後繼無力，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sluggish start, ridden along to press leader, struggled to hold position turning into home straight, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，在催策下追迫領放馬。轉入直路時難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, hampered near the 200M, had every chance (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下領放，走勢暢順。接近二百米處時受阻礙。已獲機會盡展所長。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Out wide in rear of mid-field early stages, commenced move 1400m out to join the lead 900m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段居中間之後位置，走外疊。千四米處開始上前。九百米處追上領放馬。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W5W5W) From wide draw dropped back to the rear 8Ls off the pace early stages, taken wider by rival 1000M before moving closer to midfield home turn, couldn't finish off as well as his rivals final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W5W5W) 自外檔出閘，早段墮居後列，落後領放馬八個馬位。一千米處被對手帶出較外疊。直路彎追近至中間位置。最後四百米衝刺不及對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 500M, finished off strongly, won by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。自五百米處起走第二疊，衝刺強勁，以一馬頭位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。中段落後約六個馬位。直路早段對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5 lengths back, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，被碰撞，居後列，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted in and bumped exiting stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 300m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑，被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, tended to hang right in home straight, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。直路上傾向內閃。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, angled out after passing 500M, showed some response early in straight, raced tight approaching 200M, ran on evenly until 50M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段對催策略有反應。趨近二百米處時緊迫競跑。五十米處前走勢平穩，其後收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on strongly, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持勁勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Three wide in mid-field, wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began well, taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no clear run early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空，末段衝刺強勁，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W5W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, no cover throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W5W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Stayed in touch with leaders early stages when pace was very slow, drifted back to midfield halfway, wide on home turn, run ended mid-straight and weakened noticeably final stages. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 早段跟隨領先馬匹，步速非常緩慢。半程時墮居中間位置。直路彎走外疊。直路中段無以為繼。末段明顯轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Shifted out at start, sent forward to race prominently, 1/2L back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made running, pressed in front, kicked top of home straight, headed 250m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，在領放下受追迫。直路初加速。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Broke away swiftly and sat outside the leader, fought hard when being challenged to hold on to the victory.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬外側。末段在受挑戰之際力拼，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to across, pressed leader, driven along 600m out to chase leader, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
(Jockey dropped whip at 350M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，切入追迫領放馬。六百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。末段走勢良佳，五十米處取得領先，僅勝。
（於三百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於三百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Shared early pace from a wide draw, drifted one back to 2nd 2-wide rounding home bend, folded up quickly inside final 400M.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段並排領先。轉直路彎時墮居第二位，走第二疊。最後四百米迅速力竭。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Settled handy, traveled comfortably, raced wide and without cover, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居前列。走勢暢順。在沒有遮擋下走外疊。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled only fairly, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢僅屬一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Slowly away, outpaced and well held early stages, still plenty to do top of home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，早段未能跟上步速，落後甚遠。直路初仍落後頗遠。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up, dropped to last pair into home straight, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留後。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Chased leaders early before sitting back in midfield, held up for clear running 400M to 300M then ran home mildly when asked. Not ridden out late stages when held up again.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，其後居中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困而未能望空。直路上受催策時走勢普通。末段在再度受困之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to last few from a wide barrier and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced good late impression inside final 250M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居最後數位之內，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百五十米追前甚多。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘， 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Taken across from a wide draw, settled near last throughout the event, had some work to do top of straight but couldn't pick up speed when needed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入。沿途居接近包尾位置。直路初落後甚遠，但於關鍵時刻未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Bumped out of stalls, settled in mid-field, bumped 450m out and taken wider into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百五十米處被碰撞，入直路時被帶出較外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced just off leaders, couldn't go on with leaders from 250M, swamped further on as effort wound down final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。自二百五十米處起未能跟上領先馬匹。末段力竭，被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced in 2nd , 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W1W) Made contact at start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, keen under restraint, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。在約束下搶口。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Followed leader to get across, chased leader, ridden top of home straight, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬以切入，追趕領放馬。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 居前列。走勢良佳。在鞭策下反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Settled in the last few 3 wide, niggled along to improve out wide 600M out, carried wider rounding for home, faded over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以推進，走外疊。轉直路彎時被帶出更外疊。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速， 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路初對催策略有反應，一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Never far off, baulked briefly behind runners early in home straight, could only keep on steadily without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 從未遠離領先馬匹。直路初一度在馬群之後受困。末段僅能保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, soon headed by winner 150m out, stayed on well for a clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，瞬即在一百五十米處被頭馬超越。保持佳勢，帶離餘駒，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken well behind from a poor draw trailing the field to straight, did not find much room on rail behind runners early in straight, running on when baulked again closing stages. (Tactic questioned)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後瞬即留居包尾位置。尾隨馬群至直路前。直路早段走內欄，但在馬群之後空位不足。末段上前時再度受困。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, commenced move out wide 700m out, flattened out final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處開始上前，走外疊。最後三百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leader, chased that rival down from 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，自三百米處起追趕該駒。以勁勢上前，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Raced keenly early stages and sat rear of midfield, made up some steady ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 早段搶口，居中間之後位置。穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W5W) Began from a wide barrier, gradually taken back to wide in last few, widest runner turning for home, ran on past well-beaten horses down the centre of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W5W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居最後數位之內，走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。直路上在跑道中央超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, dropped towards rear on turn, no clear run early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居後列。直路初未能望空。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced prominently on the inside, took the lead 1050M, led by 1/4L on turn, peaked and headed 400M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘一般，居前列，走內疊。一千零五十米處取得領先。直路彎領先四分一個馬位。四百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, over-raced in the early and middle stages, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) From wide draw went forward and eventually crossed to the lead before home turn, responded well under top weight mid-straight, was all out closing stages just couldn't hold off the fast finishing winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘後上前，直路彎前切入領放。直路中段在負頂磅下對催策反應良佳。末段在力拼下僅不敵衝刺凌厲的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader 2-wide, came under pressure to challenge on straightening gaining upper hand just inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰。跑過一百米處後佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Raced prominently, upsides leader entering home straight, unable to stay with that rival, stuck to task, closed up final 100m but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居前列。入直路時與領放馬並跑，其後未能跟上該駒。持續力拼，最後一百米追近，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (3W2W) Well there 3-wide early obtaining 2-wide position onto home bend, gradually faded under pressure inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(3W2W) 早段居好位，走第三疊。開始轉直路彎時走第二疊。最後二百米在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked leaders, ridden along to hold position 800m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。八百米處在催策下保持位置。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, challenged by rival final bend, headed early in home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路彎受對手挑戰。直路早段被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Shared early pace from a wide barrier before settling 2-wide in joint or outright 2nd, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段並排領先，其後並列或單騎居第二位，走第二疊。末段無以為繼，最後一百五十米被後上馬群超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Shifted in at start and bumped, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿途領放。四百米處加速，瞬即控制大局。末段距離收窄，但保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced prominently, challenged 300m out, led 150m out, in control final 50m and comfortable winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。三百米處展開挑戰。一百五十米處取得領先。最後五十米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W7W) Jumped awkwardly from a poor draw settling well back, shifted widest at the back into straight, produced good impression early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W7W) 自第十二檔出閘笨拙，遙居於後。入直路時在馬群後方移出最外疊。直路早段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W1W1W) Settled at the rear, held up from the 200m, not able to pick up once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W1W1W) 居後列。自二百米處起受困。望空後未能增速。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, strong run in home straight to lead 200m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多。直路上衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back, there to turn, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，落後約七個馬位，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Settled down in second half of the field, closed off final 400M fastest to finish equal 3rd. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居後半馬群中。最後四百米衝刺最快，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上追前甚多，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Settled in 4th over 3L off the pace 2-wide, fanned out for a run entering home straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬逾三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時向外移出以望空。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W1W) Always thereabouts, obtained rails run just inside the 800M and cover in 3rd 650M out, did not find much room until switched out for a run 150M out, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 沿途居前列。就在八百米處移入內欄，六百五十米處居第三位，有遮擋。空位不足，一百五十米處移出外疊取位。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, bumped 1000m out, ridden along 650m out to chase leaders, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處發生碰撞。六百五十米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded 600m out, ridden along 250m out, ran on well but no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫。二百五十米處受催策。走勢強勁，但未能抗衡頭馬，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W2W) Began well enough, eased back to sit in mid-division 6Ls back, picked up strongly passing 300M, ran on determinedly and got past leader close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 出閘頗佳，收慢留居中間位置，落後六個馬位。跑過三百米處時加速強勁。末段以勁勢上前，接近終點時超越領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, brought wide for home then closed off strongly to be beaten a head by the long time leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時移至外疊，其後以勁勢衝刺，以一馬頭位之差不敵領先了一段長途程的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, driven 400m out to chase leaders, not best of runs early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。直路早段未能完全望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Jumped best and ridden 2L clear in front, maintained good advantage in smart pace to home straight, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 出閘最快，在催策下領先兩個馬位。直路前以甚快步速領放，保持良好優勢。最後二百米無以為繼，被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Driven along early stages and settled in rail position of mid-field, struggled to hold position from 600m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策，居中間位置，走內欄。自六百米處起難以保持位置。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Away fast and led 1L on settling, headed soon after straightening then weakened rapidly to finish last. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領先一個馬位。入直路後瞬即被超越，其後迅速轉弱，包尾而回。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Slow to begin, settled behind midfield further back than intended, fought on steadily in the straight but couldn't quicken enough to get past leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居較賽前部署為後的中間之後位置。直路上持續力拼，但加速力不足以超越領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, under pressure 250m out, stayed on well, tired closing stages and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。二百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢。末段呈現疲態，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Driven to take up running from a poor draw, obtained rails run in front early in back straight, led until headed under pressure over 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，在催策下取得領先。對面直路初移入內欄領放。保持領先，五十米處在催策下被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, switched in for clear run top of home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時走勢暢順。直路初向內移入以望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, bumped 1000m out, challenged winner 400m out, ran on well to lead briefly 150m out, headed close home, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。一千米處與對手互相碰撞。四百米處挑戰頭馬。保持佳勢，一百五十米處一度取得領先。接近終點時被超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Not the quickest out, settled midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘並非最快，居中間位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。難以穩定走勢，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，末段保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Heavily bumped out of stalls, ridden along to chase leader, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，受催策以追趕領放馬。三百米處迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, very wide into straight, inconvenienced near 350M, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位，走大外疊。接近三百五十米處時受妨礙。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, effort 500m out to chase leaders, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處發力追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled well back in last from a wide barrier, gained one closer on rail 800M out, improving until out of room 150M out, steadied again 50M out, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後遙居包尾位置。八百米處沿欄追前一位。持續推進直至一百五十米處空位不足。五十米處再度收慢，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to switch 500m out, clear run 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處未能轉換跑線。二百米處望空，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上，早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, no clear run in the Straight, never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, held up and never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段受困。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, eased when detached 200m out.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。二百米處被拋離時收慢。
（流鼻血。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Bivouac from Atlanta Peach, a daughter of Bullbars. Horses by the same sire include Absolute Heart and Ace Eagle. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1200m) in New Zealand. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth under slight pressure, beaten by 5-3/4Ls, over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but perhaps he could run well.
formguide.comments_chi: 「露營友」(Bivouac)之後，在港同父馬包括「超和平」及「祥勝鷹駒」等駒，生母出自Bullbars。來港前在紐西蘭一出一捷，頭馬為一場1200米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第八名，落後頭馬5.75個馬位。不似能一出即勝，惟或可交出不俗表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W5W) Tracked leaders out wide without cover, improved halfway out, taken very wide into home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時推進。入直路時移出大外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer on turn, 3 wide turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well then eased back to midfield on settling, steadied 500M losing ground, responded well when asked and made steady progress towards the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後收慢留居中間位置。五百米處收慢，失地。對催策反應良佳，末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑。居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W) Chased leaders in a 3-wide position without cover, challenged hard for the lead from 300M but couldn't quite get past leader, lost 2nd closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。自三百米處起力拼，爭奪領先，但未能超越領放馬。末段失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, pushed along 500m out, limited headway, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策，略為上前。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well from the rails draw, amongst leaders early before settling one back, drifted further back to some 3L off the pace onto course proper, renewed effort inside final 150M but did not find much room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居領先馬群中，其後落後一個馬位。跑離分支直路時進一步墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。最後一百五十米再度發力，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in midfield, fought on steadily without making any serious challenge in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路上持續力拼，但未能真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Crowded for room after the start, ended up racing at the back of the field, had some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest and almost claimed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路初落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，幾乎跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in last few, 3-wide rounding home bend and baulked for a run in home straight until barged his way out over 50M out
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走第三疊。直路上受困，直至五十米處取位上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, commenced move approaching 350M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly to make frame, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat midfield, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居中間位置。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, outpaced early stages, still in last place into home straight, eye-catching headway from rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，早段未能跟上步速。入直路時仍居包尾位置。末段自後列以悅目走勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride at the rear, 7Ls to make up 400M, made some progress without posing serious threat to the leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處落後七個馬位。末段略為追前，但未能真正威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W3W) In rear after slowly away, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後一百米衝刺強勁，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時與一駒互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Restrained to race in midfield along the fence, was held up over the home turn when pace quickened, closed off fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎步速加快時受困。末段在催策下衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Held up last from widest draw, rail position throughout, chased along on bend, lacked pace to challenge, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。沿途走內欄。直路彎追趕對手。速度不足以展開挑戰。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden to better than midfield in 6th early some 3L off the pace, badly crowded and dropped quickly out of contention 600M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段受催策，居中間之前第六位，落後領放馬約三個馬位。六百米處嚴重受擠迫及迅速墮退，再無爭勝機會。從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速，二百米處領先。一百米處被頭馬超越，其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced prominently, moved up to outside of leader before halfway, led 200m out, asserted and won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居前列。半程前推進至領放馬外側。二百米處取得領先。控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。末段以勁勢衝刺，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear along the inside, failed to run on in the straight. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路上未能追前。從未能構成威脅。
